PRODUCT COMPARISON

In case there is any confusion in your mind regarding different types of permanent hair extensions, do read the following information. In case of keratin bond extensions the bond is very strong, hence the extensions last for upto 4 months. So if you want your hair extensions to stay in the hair for a long period of time, keratin bond extensions are an excellent option. glue hair  extensions are not ideal for those who do not wish to use any glue on their hair or those with very fine hair. Tape extensions are the safest method in permanent extensions and are very quick to apply and remove.

However, these last for only up to 2 months. Tape extensions are ideal for those with thin hair as they are least damaging.
Micro ring extensions are ideal for those who do not wish to apply any glue to their hair. These extensions last up to 3 months and the application and removal is extremely easy. If you want your hair to have a lot of movement then micro ring extensions are a good option

products.title: Tape in Hair Extensions
products.body_html:
ABOUT THE PRODUCT

One of the safest method of application, perfect to add length, volume or add coloured panels. Tape-in extensions are about 1.75 inches wide. One skinny strip of your natural hair goes in between them. The way they are placed is like a sandwich : your own hair actually gets taped between two strips of hair extensions. The ideal solution for women who are looking for premium hair extensions with an invisible and seamless application, lasting from 2-3 months with appropriate care and maintenance. With Alchemane Permanent extensions, the hair extensionist can achieve any kind of result: lengthening, thickening, sides application, highlights, lowlights and also updos

Tape hair extensions in mumbai are among our bestsellers and the most popular as the method of application is extremely simple. You can have fuller and longer hair in less than an hour. The extensions can be fully customised to suit your needs in terms color, length and texture. Since they are made from real human hair, and stuck to ur own hair, they look perfectly natural.

products.title: One Set Clip In Hair Extensions
products.body_html:
Clip-in Hair extensions are made from 100% remy human hair and feature a combination of varied hair lengths that taper off at the ends to mimic your natural hair best (also known as single-drawn hair). They come straight and can be styled to waves or curls using hot tools. New to Clip-In hair extensions? Check out our Ultimate Guide that has lots of frequently asked questions.

Our extensions are dyed using a multi-tonal adapt coloring system, which means there are subtle highlights and lowlights (lighter and darker strands) throughout each set. This gives it movement, dimension, and depth. It also ensures that the extensions blend with your natural hair, even if your hair color is slightly different. You can also have them dyed or toned darker by a professional hair colorist. Here is an article walking you through our dyeing do’s and dont’s.

Our Classic Collection

Classic Clip-Ins feature fabric-stitched wefts that are flexible and are good to add more volume to your roots. They are offered in a variety of different weights and lengths to cater to many different hair types. The higher the grams, the more hair that is attached to each weft. The individual strands themselves will remain consistent in thickness. Click here to learn how to figure out your hair type and to choose the right set.
